source: 多语种语法点分级表_英日韩 · 教研初版

points.name: be 动词现在时
points.structure: S + am/is/are + 表语
points.meaning: 说明身份、状态、属性或位置
points.example: The lab is on the second floor.
points.translation: 实验室在二楼。
points.note: 托福听力场景信息定位

points.name: 一般现在时第三人称单数
points.structure: S(3sg) + V-s/es
points.meaning: 陈述习惯、事实、普遍规律
points.example: The experiment requires precise timing.
points.translation: 该实验需要精确计时。

points.name: 现在进行时
points.structure: S + am/is/are + V-ing
points.meaning: 动作正在进行或现阶段持续
points.example: Researchers are testing a new vaccine.
points.translation: 研究人员正在测试一种新疫苗。
points.note: 听力中动作发生的时点

points.name: 一般过去时（规则动词）
points.structure: S + V-ed
points.meaning: 过去某时发生并已结束的动作
points.synonym: 现在完成时（与现在有关联）
points.example: The team collected samples last summer.
points.translation: 团队去年夏天采集了样本。

points.name: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
points.structure: S + V₂
points.meaning: 同上，用于不规则动词
points.example: The professor brought the data to class.
points.translation: 教授把数据带到了课堂。

points.name: 一般将来时 will
points.structure: S + will + V
points.meaning: 对未来的预测或即时决定
points.example: The results will appear in next month's issue.
points.translation: 结果将发表在下月期刊上。

points.name: be going to 表计划
points.structure: S + am/is/are going to + V
points.meaning: 已预先安排的意图或明显迹象
points.example: We are going to replicate the study.
points.translation: 我们打算重复这项研究。

points.name: there be 存在句
points.structure: There + be + 名词 + 地点
points.meaning: 表示某处存在某物
points.example: There are three possible explanations.
points.translation: 存在三种可能的解释。

points.name: 名词复数规则变化
points.structure: N + -s/-es
points.meaning: 表示两个及以上可数名词
points.example: The charts show changes in rainfall.
points.translation: 图表显示降水量的变化。

points.name: 名词不规则复数
points.structure: datum→data, criterion→criteria
points.meaning: 拉丁/希腊来源名词的复数形式
points.example: These data support the hypothesis.
points.translation: 这些数据支持该假设。

points.name: 不可数名词与量词
points.structure: a piece of / an item of / much + 不可数
points.meaning: 不可数名词借量词表数量
points.example: She gave me some useful information.
points.translation: 她给了我一些有用的信息。

points.name: 不定冠词 a/an
points.structure: a/an + 可数名词单数
points.meaning: 首次提及、泛指一类中的一个
points.example: He is an honest researcher.
points.translation: 他是一位诚实的研究者。

points.name: 定冠词 the 基本指称
points.structure: the + 名词
points.meaning: 特指双方已知或上文已提的事物
points.example: The sample we tested was contaminated.
points.translation: 我们检测的那个样本被污染了。

points.name: 零冠词
points.structure: ∅ + 抽象名词/复数类指
points.meaning: 泛指不可数或复数名词时不加冠词
points.example: Water is essential for life.
points.translation: 水对生命必不可少。

points.name: 人称代词主格与宾格
points.structure: I/you/he... 与 me/you/him...
points.meaning: 分别充当主语与宾语
points.example: She explained the method to us.
points.translation: 她向我们解释了该方法。

points.name: 形容词性物主代词
points.structure: my/your/his/her/our/their + 名词
points.meaning: 表示所属，后必须接名词
points.example: Their findings differ from ours.
points.translation: 他们的发现与我们的不同。

points.name: 名词性物主代词
points.structure: mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs
points.meaning: 独立使用，相当于物主代词+名词
points.example: This conclusion is hers, not mine.
points.translation: 这个结论是她的，不是我的。

points.name: 反身代词
points.structure: -self/-selves
points.meaning: 动作返回到主语自身或强调
points.example: The machine calibrates itself every hour.
points.translation: 机器每小时自动校准。

points.name: 指示代词
points.structure: this/that/these/those
points.meaning: 近指与远指、单数与复数
points.example: These results contradict those reported earlier.
points.translation: 这些结果与早前报告的结果相矛盾。

points.name: 名词所有格
points.structure: N's / of + N
points.meaning: 表示所属关系
points.example: The study's limitations are obvious.
points.translation: 这项研究的局限很明显。

points.name: 形容词位置与顺序
points.structure: 限定词 + 评价 + 大小 + 年龄 + 形状 + 颜色 + 来源 + 材料 + 用途 + 名词
points.meaning: 多个形容词并列时的固定顺序
points.example: a small round wooden table
points.translation: 一张小圆木桌

points.name: 副词构成与位置
points.structure: 形容词 + -ly；置于动词前后
points.meaning: 修饰动词、形容词或全句
points.example: The team carefully recorded each reading.
points.translation: 团队仔细记录了每个读数。

points.name: 比较级构成
points.structure: 短词 -er；长词 more + 形容词
points.meaning: 两者之间的程度比较
points.example: This method is more reliable than the old one.
points.translation: 这个方法比旧方法更可靠。

points.name: 最高级构成
points.structure: the + 短词 -est / most + 形容词 + 范围
points.meaning: 三者及以上中的最高程度
points.example: It is the most efficient system available.
points.translation: 这是现有最高效的系统。

points.name: as...as 同级比较
points.structure: as + 形容词/副词 + as + 比较对象
points.meaning: 表示两者程度相同
points.example: The new model is as accurate as the previous one.
points.translation: 新模型与旧模型一样准确。
points.note: 第二个 as 不可省

points.name: 时间介词 at/in/on
points.structure: at + 时刻；on + 具体日；in + 月/年/季节
points.meaning: 时间点的介词选择
points.example: The lecture begins at nine on Monday.
points.translation: 讲座周一九点开始。

points.name: 地点介词 at/in/on
points.structure: at + 点；in + 空间内部；on + 表面
points.meaning: 空间关系的介词选择
points.example: The samples are stored in the freezer.
points.translation: 样本存放在冷冻柜里。

points.name: 情态动词 can/could
points.structure: can/could + V
points.meaning: 能力、许可、请求；could 更委婉
points.example: Could you repeat the last figure?
points.translation: 你能重复一下最后一个数字吗？

points.name: must 与 have to
points.structure: must + V；have to + V
points.meaning: must 表主观必要或强推测，have to 表客观义务
points.example: You must cite every source you use.
points.translation: 你必须引用使用的每一处来源。

points.name: may 与 might
points.structure: may/might + V
points.meaning: 可能性；might 可能性更低
points.example: The discrepancy may result from measurement error.
points.translation: 这一差异可能源于测量误差。

points.name: should 表建议
points.structure: should + V
points.meaning: 建议、期望或温和义务
points.example: The report should include a methods section.
points.translation: 报告应包含方法部分。

points.name: 祈使句与否定祈使
points.structure: V + 宾语；(Don't/Never) + V
points.meaning: 发出指令、请求或警告
points.example: Do not adjust the settings during calibration.
points.translation: 校准期间不要调整设置。

points.name: 一般疑问句
points.structure: 助动词/be + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: 以 yes/no 回答的提问
points.example: Did the team finish the survey?
points.translation: 团队完成调查了吗？

points.name: 特殊疑问句语序
points.structure: 疑问词 + 助动词 + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: 就特定成分提问
points.example: Why did the sample degrade so quickly?
points.translation: 样本为何降解得这么快？

points.name: 否定句构成
points.structure: 助动词/be + not + 谓语
points.meaning: 否定谓语或句子
points.example: The results do not support that claim.
points.translation: 结果不支持该主张。

points.name: 并列连词 and/but/or/so
points.structure: 分句 + and/but/or/so + 分句
points.meaning: 连接对等成分或分句
points.example: The sample was small, so the findings are tentative.
points.translation: 样本量小，因此结论是初步的。

points.name: 不定式表目的
points.structure: to + V（可置于句首或句末）
points.meaning: 表示目的或意图
points.example: The team repeated the test to verify the result.
points.translation: 团队重复测试以验证结果。

points.name: 动名词作宾语
points.structure: enjoy/avoid/finish/suggest + V-ing
points.meaning: 动词后接动名词作宾语
points.example: The survey avoided asking leading questions.
points.translation: 该调查避免提出诱导性问题。

points.name: 现在完成时（经历）
points.structure: have/has + been to / done
points.meaning: 表示至今的经历或次数
points.example: She has been to three research stations.
points.translation: 她去过三个研究站。
points.note: have been to 与 have gone to

points.name: 现在完成时（结果）
points.structure: have/has + 过去分词
points.meaning: 过去动作对现在造成的结果或影响
points.example: The team has lost the original recordings.
points.translation: 团队弄丢了原始录音。

points.name: 被动语态（一般现在时）
points.structure: S + am/is/are + 过去分词
points.meaning: 强调受事或施事不明确
points.example: Samples are stored at minus eighty degrees.
points.translation: 样本保存在零下八十度。

points.name: 被动语态（一般过去时）
points.structure: S + was/were + 过去分词
points.meaning: 过去发生的被动动作
points.example: The data were collected over six months.
points.translation: 数据历时六个月收集。

points.name: 定语从句（关系代词作主语）
points.structure: 先行词 + who/which/that + 谓语
points.meaning: 修饰人用 who，修饰物用 which/that
points.example: Students who missed the lab session need to reschedule.
points.translation: 缺席实验课的学生需要重新安排。

points.name: 定语从句（关系代词作宾语可省略）
points.structure: 先行词 + (whom/which/that) + 主谓
points.meaning: 关系代词作宾语时可省略
points.synonym: 关系代词作主语不可省
points.example: The article (that) she cited is outdated.
points.translation: 她引用的那篇文章已过时。

points.name: 时间状语从句 when/while/as
points.structure: when/while/as + 从句
points.meaning: when 表时点，while 表持续或对比，as 表同步
points.example: While the sample was heating, the sensor failed.
points.translation: 样本加热时传感器失灵了。

points.name: 时间状语从句 before/after
points.structure: before/after + 从句或名词
points.meaning: 表示先后顺序
points.example: The solution must be stirred before it is heated.
points.translation: 溶液加热前必须搅拌。

points.name: if 真实条件句
points.structure: If + 一般现在时，主句 + 将来时
points.meaning: 表示可能实现的条件
points.example: If the temperature rises, the reaction will accelerate.
points.translation: 若温度升高，反应将加速。

points.name: 宾语从句 that 引导陈述
points.structure: V + that + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: that 无实义，仅起引导作用，可省略
points.example: The authors claim that the effect is permanent.
points.translation: 作者声称该效应是永久的。

points.name: 宾语从句陈述语序
points.structure: V + 疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: 疑问词引导的从句用陈述语序
points.example: The report explains why the trial failed.
points.translation: 报告解释了试验失败的原因。

points.name: 数词与序数词
points.structure: 基数词/序数词 + 名词
points.meaning: 表示数量与顺序
points.example: The second trial produced identical results.
points.translation: 第二次试验产生了相同结果。

points.name: 时间与日期表达
points.structure: 月份 + 日 + 年；at/in/on 搭配
points.meaning: 书面与口头时间表达差异
points.example: The deadline is March 15, 2027.
points.translation: 截止日期是2027年3月15日。

points.name: 频率副词
points.structure: always/usually/often/seldom/never
points.meaning: 表示动作发生频率，位于实义动词前、be 后
points.example: The sensor rarely needs recalibration.
points.translation: 传感器很少需要重新校准。

points.name: 介词短语作状语
points.structure: 介词 + 名词 + 主句
points.meaning: 表示时间、地点、方式、原因
points.example: In the second phase, participants completed a survey.
points.translation: 第二阶段参与者完成了问卷。

points.name: 动词短语（动词+介词）
points.structure: V + prep（look into/take on/carry out）
points.meaning: 整体具有特定词义，介词不可随意更换
points.example: The lab carried out three independent trials.
points.translation: 实验室进行了三次独立试验。

points.name: 形容词+介词固定搭配
points.structure: be + adj + prep（good at/interested in/capable of）
points.meaning: 形容词与介词的固定组合
points.example: The team is capable of handling large datasets.
points.translation: 团队有能力处理大数据集。

points.name: 感叹句 What/How
points.structure: What + (a/an) + adj + n + 主谓；How + adj/adv + 主谓
points.meaning: 表达强烈情感
points.example: What a remarkable finding this is!
points.translation: 这是多么惊人的发现！

points.name: 反意疑问句基础
points.structure: 陈述句 + 简短问句
points.meaning: 前肯后否、前否后肯
points.example: The results are reproducible, aren't they?
points.translation: 结果可重复，不是吗？

points.name: 过去进行时
points.structure: S + was/were + V-ing
points.meaning: 过去某时正在进行的动作
points.example: The assistant was preparing the slides when the power failed.
points.translation: 断电时助手正在准备幻灯片。

points.name: 过去完成时
points.structure: had + 过去分词
points.meaning: 过去的过去，先于另一过去动作
points.example: The team had finished the trial before the grant ended.
points.translation: 资助结束前团队已完成试验。

points.name: 现在完成进行时
points.structure: have/has been + V-ing
points.meaning: 动作从过去持续到现在并可能继续
points.example: They have been monitoring the site since 2021.
points.translation: 他们自2021年以来一直在监测该场地。

points.name: 将来进行时
points.structure: will be + V-ing
points.meaning: 将来某时正在进行的动作
points.example: At noon tomorrow, the team will be running the final test.
points.translation: 明天中午团队将正在做最后测试。

points.name: 将来完成时
points.structure: will have + 过去分词
points.meaning: 到将来某时为止已完成的动作
points.example: By 2030, the city will have doubled its green space.
points.translation: 到2030年，该市绿地面积将翻倍。

points.name: 现在完成时与一般过去时辨析
points.structure: have done（关联现在） vs did（过去事实）
points.meaning: 完成体强调与现在的关联，过去时强调过去事件
points.example: The policy has reduced emissions since 2019; in 2018 alone, emissions fell by 3%.
points.translation: 该政策自2019年起减排；仅2018年排放就下降了3%。

points.name: 情态动词表推测
points.structure: must/may/might/can't + V
points.meaning: 按确定程度从高到低表示推测
points.example: The sample must be contaminated; the readings are inconsistent.
points.translation: 样本一定被污染了，读数不一致。

points.name: used to / be used to / would
points.structure: used to + V；be used to + N/V-ing；would + V
points.meaning: used to 表过去习惯，be used to 表习惯于，would 表过去反复
points.example: The site used to host a factory; residents are used to the noise.
points.translation: 该场地曾是工厂；居民已习惯噪音。

points.name: 虚拟条件句（与现在事实相反）
points.structure: If + 过去式（be 用 were），主句 + would/could + V
points.meaning: 假设与现在事实相反
points.example: If the budget were larger, the team could extend the study.
points.translation: 若预算更多，团队可延长研究。

points.name: 虚拟条件句（与过去事实相反）
points.structure: If + had done，主句 + would have done
points.meaning: 假设与过去事实相反
points.example: If they had randomized the sample, the bias would have been smaller.
points.translation: 若他们对样本随机化，偏差会更小。

points.name: wish 从句
points.structure: wish + 过去式 / had done / would do
points.meaning: 表示与现在、过去或将来相反的愿望
points.example: I wish the data were available for reanalysis.
points.translation: 我真希望这些数据可供再分析。

points.name: it 作形式主语
points.structure: It + be + adj/n + (for/of sb) + to do/that 从句
points.meaning: 真正主语后置，it 占位
points.example: It is difficult to replicate the original conditions.
points.translation: 复现原始条件很困难。

points.name: it 作形式宾语
points.structure: V + it + adj/n + to do/that 从句
points.meaning: 真正宾语后置，it 占位
points.example: The committee considers it essential to verify the source.
points.translation: 委员会认为核实来源至关重要。

points.name: 不定式完成式
points.structure: to have + 过去分词
points.meaning: 表示不定式动作先于谓语动作发生
points.example: The storm seems to have damaged the sensor.
points.translation: 暴风雨似乎损坏了传感器。

points.name: 不定式作定语
points.structure: 名词 + to do（常与序数词、能力词搭配）
points.meaning: 修饰名词，表示将要发生或应做的事
points.example: She was the first researcher to publish the dataset.
points.translation: 她是首位公开该数据集的研究者。

points.name: 动名词作主语
points.structure: V-ing + 谓语（视为单数）
points.meaning: 表示抽象动作或习惯性行为
points.synonym: 不定式作主语（具体一次）
points.example: Replicating the experiment proved harder than expected.
points.translation: 复现该实验比预想的更难。
points.note: 动名词主语谓语用单数

points.name: remember/forget/stop 后接 to do 与 doing
points.structure: remember to do（记得要做）/ doing（记得做过）
points.meaning: 同一动词后接不同非谓语，语义相反
points.example: He stopped to check the gauge; he stopped recording at noon.
points.translation: 他停下来检查仪表；他中午停止记录。

points.name: try/mean/regret 的语义分化
points.structure: try to do（努力）/ doing（试验）；mean to do（打算）/ doing（意味着）
points.meaning: 非谓语形式改变词义
points.example: Missing the control group means losing comparability.
points.translation: 缺少对照组意味着失去可比性。

points.name: 分词作定语
points.structure: V-ing（主动/进行） / V-ed（被动/完成） + 名词
points.meaning: 短语式定语，相当于定语从句
points.example: The data collected in 2019 remain the most reliable.
points.translation: 2019年收集的数据仍最可靠。

points.name: 分词作状语
points.structure: V-ing/V-ed + 主句
points.meaning: 表示时间、原因、条件、伴随或结果
points.example: Having controlled for age, the researchers found a clear trend.
points.translation: 控制年龄变量后，研究者发现了明显趋势。

points.name: 独立主格结构
points.structure: 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语 + 主句
points.meaning: 自带逻辑主语的状语结构
points.example: The temperature having stabilized, the team began the test.
points.translation: 温度稳定后，团队开始测试。
points.note: 主语不同时用独立主格

points.name: 不定式被动式
points.structure: to be + 过去分词
points.meaning: 不定式逻辑主语为受事
points.example: The samples need to be stored at low temperature.
points.translation: 样本需低温保存。
points.note: need to be done 结构

points.name: 定语从句 whose
points.structure: 先行词 + whose + 名词
points.meaning: 表示所属关系，指人或物
points.example: The scientist whose theory was challenged defended her method.
points.translation: 理论受到挑战的那位科学家捍卫了自己的方法。

points.name: 定语从句 where/when/why
points.structure: 先行词 + where/when/why + 完整从句
points.meaning: 关系副词在从句中作状语
points.example: The lab where the samples were processed has closed.
points.translation: 处理样本的那间实验室已关闭。
points.note: 从句成分完整才用关系副词

points.name: 介词 + 关系代词
points.structure: prep + whom/which + 从句
points.meaning: 正式语体中关系代词前置介词
points.example: The method on which the conclusion rests is questionable.
points.translation: 该结论所依据的方法值得怀疑。

points.name: which 指代整个主句
points.structure: 主句, which + 谓语
points.meaning: 非限定定语从句指代前文整句
points.synonym: as 引导的非限定从句
points.example: The trial failed, which surprised no one.
points.translation: 试验失败了，这并不令人意外。

points.name: as 引导非限定定语从句
points.structure: as + 从句（可置于句首、句中、句末）
points.meaning: 表示正如、如同，常见 as is known
points.example: As is often the case, the pilot study revealed design flaws.
points.translation: 正如常见情况，试点研究暴露了设计缺陷。

points.name: 限制性与非限制性定语从句
points.structure: 限定从句无逗号；非限定有逗号
points.meaning: 限定从句不可或缺，非限定仅补充信息
points.example: The students who completed the survey received credit.
points.translation: 完成问卷的学生获得了学分。

points.name: 同位语从句
points.structure: 抽象名词 + that + 完整从句
points.meaning: 解释名词的具体内容
points.example: The claim that the drug is safe lacks evidence.
points.translation: 该药物安全的说法缺乏证据。

points.name: whether/if 引导名词性从句
points.structure: whether/if + 完整从句
points.meaning: 表示是否；句首与介词后用 whether
points.example: Whether the results generalize remains unclear.
points.translation: 结果能否推广仍不清楚。

points.name: what 引导名词性从句
points.structure: what + 缺成分的从句
points.meaning: what 兼作连接词与句子成分
points.example: What the study lacks is a control group.
points.translation: 该研究缺少的是对照组。

points.name: whatever/whoever 引导
points.structure: whatever/whoever/whichever + 从句
points.meaning: 表示无论什么/谁，兼具强调
points.example: Whoever designed the protocol overlooked the sample size.
points.translation: 设计该方案的人忽略了样本量。

points.name: 主语从句与 it 移位
points.structure: That + 从句 + 谓语；It + be + adj + that 从句
points.meaning: 长主语后置以平衡句子
points.example: That the two variables correlate does not prove causation.
points.translation: 两变量相关并不能证明因果。

points.name: 表语从句
points.structure: be + that/whether/what + 从句
points.meaning: 从句作表语说明主语内容
points.example: The problem is that the sample was not random.
points.translation: 问题在于样本并非随机抽取。
points.note: reason is that 不用 because

points.name: 让步状语从句 although/though/even though
points.structure: although/though/even though + 从句，主句
points.meaning: 表示尽管，主句不再加 but
points.example: Although the sample was small, the effect size was large.
points.translation: 尽管样本小，效应量却很大。

points.name: while/whereas 表对比
points.structure: while/whereas + 从句，主句
points.meaning: 表示两者对照
points.example: Urban soils absorb heat, whereas rural soils retain moisture.
points.translation: 城市土壤吸热，而乡村土壤保水。

points.name: as/though 引导让步倒装
points.structure: 形容词/副词/名词 + as/though + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: 书面语让步倒装
points.example: Difficult as the task was, the team met the deadline.
points.translation: 任务虽难，团队仍按期完成。

points.name: unless 引导条件
points.structure: unless + 肯定从句
points.meaning: 除非，等于 if not
points.example: The reaction will not proceed unless a catalyst is added.
points.translation: 除非加入催化剂，反应不会进行。

points.name: as long as / provided that
points.structure: as long as / provided (that) + 从句
points.meaning: 表示只要、条件是
points.example: The findings hold as long as the assumptions are met.
points.translation: 只要假设成立，结论就成立。

points.name: 原因状语 because/since/as/for
points.structure: because/since/as + 从句；for + 分句
points.meaning: because 最强，since/as 较弱，for 补充说明
points.example: The experiment was repeated because the first run was invalid.
points.translation: 因第一次运行无效，实验被重复。

points.name: 目的状语 so that / in order that
points.structure: so that / in order that + 从句（常含 can/could/may）
points.meaning: 表示目的
points.example: The protocol was simplified so that technicians could follow it.
points.translation: 方案被简化以便技术员遵循。

points.name: 结果状语 so...that / such...that
points.structure: so + adj/adv + that；such + (a/an) + adj + n + that
points.meaning: 表示程度导致的结果
points.example: The signal was so weak that the receiver missed it.
points.translation: 信号太弱，接收器未能捕捉。

points.name: as soon as 引导时间状语
points.structure: as soon as + 一般现在时，主句 + 将来/过去
points.meaning: 表示一……就
points.example: As soon as the data arrive, the model will update.
points.translation: 数据一到，模型就会更新。

points.name: hardly...when / no sooner...than
points.structure: Hardly had + S + done + when...；No sooner had + S + done + than...
points.meaning: 表示刚一……就，主句用倒装与过去完成时
points.example: Hardly had the alarm sounded when the system shut down.
points.translation: 警报刚响，系统就关闭了。
points.note: 固定搭配 than/when 不可换

points.name: 倍数表达
points.structure: A + be + 倍数 + as + adj + as + B；倍数 + the + n + of
points.meaning: 表示比较中的倍数关系
points.example: The new array is three times as sensitive as the old one.
points.translation: 新阵列灵敏度是旧阵列的三倍。

points.name: the more..., the more...
points.structure: the + 比较级 + 从句，the + 比较级 + 主句
points.meaning: 表示越……越……
points.example: The longer the exposure, the clearer the image.
points.translation: 曝光时间越长，图像越清晰。

points.name: 比较级修饰语
points.structure: much/far/even/still/a lot + 比较级
points.meaning: 加强比较程度
points.example: The second model is far more robust than the first.
points.translation: 第二个模型远比第一个稳健。

points.name: 最高级与比较级互换
points.structure: 最高级 = 比较级 + than any other
points.meaning: 同一语义的两种表达
points.example: No other method is as efficient as this one.
points.translation: 没有其他方法比这个方法更高效。

points.name: 平行结构
points.structure: A, B, and C 形式一致
points.meaning: 并列成分词性与句法形式统一
points.example: The course teaches how to design, conduct, and report experiments.
points.translation: 该课程教授如何设计、实施与报告实验。

points.name: not only...but also
points.structure: Not only + 倒装/成分，but also + 对应成分
points.meaning: 表示递进，连接对等成分
points.example: Not only does the method reduce cost, but it also improves accuracy.
points.translation: 该方法不仅降低成本，还提高准确性。
points.note: 句首 not only 倒装

points.name: either...or / neither...nor
points.structure: either A or B；neither A nor B
points.meaning: 表示二选一或两者都不
points.example: Neither the sampling method nor the analysis was adequate.
points.translation: 抽样方法与分析都不充分。

points.name: 主谓一致：就近原则
points.structure: either...or / neither...nor / there be + 最近主语
points.meaning: 谓语与最近的名词一致
points.example: Neither the students nor the instructor was notified.
points.translation: 学生和讲师都没有收到通知。

points.name: 主谓一致：集合名词
points.structure: family/team/government + 单数或复数谓语
points.meaning: 视为整体用单数，强调成员用复数
points.example: The team has published its findings.
points.translation: 团队发表了其研究结果。

points.name: 主谓一致：不定代词
points.structure: everyone/each/either/neither + 单数谓语
points.meaning: 不定代词作主语视为单数
points.example: Each of the samples was analyzed twice.
points.translation: 每个样本都被分析了两次。
points.note: each of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语

points.name: 主谓一致：分数与百分比
points.structure: 分数/百分比 + of + 名词，谓语随名词
points.meaning: 谓语与 of 后名词的数一致
points.synonym: a number of / the number of
points.example: Sixty percent of the sample was unusable.
points.translation: 样本的百分之六十无法使用。

points.name: 代词指代一致
points.structure: 代词与先行词在人称、数、性上一致
points.meaning: 避免指代歧义
points.example: Each participant submitted his or her own log.
points.translation: 每位参与者提交了自己的记录。
points.note: 单数先行词用单数代词

points.name: 复合不定代词
points.structure: someone/anything/nothing/everybody
points.meaning: 指代不特定的人或物，作主语用单数
points.example: Nothing in the report supports that conclusion.
points.translation: 报告中没有任何内容支持该结论。

points.name: few/little 与 a few/a little
points.structure: few/little（几乎没有）；a few/a little（有一些）
points.meaning: 可数用 few，不可数用 little，带 a 表肯定
points.example: Few studies have addressed this question.
points.translation: 很少有研究涉及这个问题。

points.name: many/much/a lot of
points.structure: many + 可数复数；much + 不可数
points.meaning: 表示大量
points.example: Much of the evidence is indirect.
points.translation: 大部分证据是间接的。
points.note: 口语多用 a lot of

points.name: the + 形容词表群体
points.structure: the + adj（the poor/the elderly）
points.meaning: 指代一类人，谓语用复数
points.example: The elderly are more vulnerable to heat stress.
points.translation: 老年人更易受热应激影响。

points.name: 冠词固定搭配
points.structure: in the long run / at present / on the whole
points.meaning: 固定短语中的冠词不可随意替换
points.example: In the long run, prevention costs less than treatment.
points.translation: 从长远看，预防比治疗成本更低。

points.name: 介词辨析：in/on/at 抽象用法
points.structure: in + 领域；on + 主题；at + 点
points.meaning: 抽象语境中的介词选择
points.example: The paper focuses on the effects of urbanization.
points.translation: 论文聚焦城市化的影响。

points.name: 短语动词的及物性
points.structure: V + prep（及物） / V + adv（可分离）
points.meaning: 决定能否用于被动、宾语位置
points.example: The committee put off the decision until spring.
points.translation: 委员会将决定推迟到春季。

points.name: 现在完成时被动
points.structure: have/has been + 过去分词
points.meaning: 强调动作已完成且主语为受事
points.example: The samples have been stored at low temperature.
points.translation: 样本一直低温保存。

points.name: should have done
points.structure: should + have + 过去分词
points.meaning: 表示本应做而未做的遗憾或批评
points.example: The team should have validated the instrument first.
points.translation: 团队本应先校验仪器。
points.note: 与 must have done 区分

points.name: needn't have done / didn't need to
points.structure: needn't have done（做了但不必）；didn't need to（不必做，未做）
points.meaning: 两种结构语义不同
points.example: You needn't have repeated the test; the first run was valid.
points.translation: 你不必重复测试，第一次运行有效。

points.name: suggest/insist/demand + (should) do
points.structure: suggest/insist/demand/propose + that + S + (should) + V
points.meaning: 表示建议、要求、命令的虚拟语气
points.example: The panel recommended that the study be replicated.
points.translation: 专家组建议重复该研究。

points.name: It is necessary/important that
points.structure: It is + adj + that + S + (should) + V
points.meaning: 评价性形容词后的虚拟语气
points.example: It is essential that every sample be labeled.
points.translation: 每个样本都必须贴标签。

points.name: lest / for fear that
points.structure: lest + S + (should) + V；for fear that + 从句
points.meaning: 表示以免、唯恐
points.example: The lid was sealed lest moisture enter the chamber.
points.translation: 盖子被密封，以免湿气进入腔体。

points.name: but for / otherwise 含蓄条件
points.structure: But for + N, 主句 + would have done；otherwise + 主句
points.meaning: 用短语代替 if 从句
points.example: But for the backup generator, the samples would have thawed.
points.translation: 若无备用发电机，样本本会解冻。

points.name: 混合虚拟条件句
points.structure: If + had done（过去），主句 + would + V（现在）
points.meaning: 条件与结果发生在不同时间
points.example: If the team had secured funding, the project would still be running.
points.translation: 若当初拿到资助，项目现在仍在运行。

points.name: 虚拟语气倒装（Were/Had/Should）
points.structure: Were I...；Had I...；Should you...（省略 if）
points.meaning: 书面语中省略 if 的倒装虚拟
points.synonym: if 引导的虚拟条件句
points.example: Had the alarm been tested, the failure would have been detected.
points.translation: 若警报器测试过，故障本会被发现。

points.name: 否定词前置倒装
points.structure: Never/Seldom/Little/Not until + 助动词 + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: 否定或半否定词居首引起部分倒装
points.example: Not until the 1990s did researchers recognize the pattern.
points.translation: 直到20世纪90年代研究者才认识到这一模式。

points.name: only + 状语前置倒装
points.structure: Only + 状语 + 助动词 + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: only 修饰状语置于句首时倒装
points.example: Only by repeated testing can the effect be confirmed.
points.translation: 只有通过反复测试才能确认该效应。

points.name: so/neither/nor 附和倒装
points.structure: So + 助动词 + 主语；Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语
points.meaning: 表示同样或也不
points.example: The first trial failed; so did the second.
points.translation: 第一次试验失败，第二次也是。

points.name: 地点状语前置倒装
points.structure: 地点状语 + 谓语 + 主语（主语为名词）
points.meaning: 强调地点，常见于描写
points.example: On the slide lay a thin layer of sediment.
points.translation: 载玻片上有一层薄沉积物。

points.name: 强调句 it is...that
points.structure: It is/was + 被强调成分 + that/who + 其余
points.meaning: 强调主语、宾语或状语
points.example: It was the calibration error that invalidated the results.
points.translation: 正是校准误差使结果失效。

points.name: 强调句与定语从句辨析
points.structure: It is...that 可还原；定语从句不可
points.meaning: 判断 that 前是否为被强调成分
points.example: It was in 2019 that the policy took effect.
points.translation: 该政策是在2019年生效的。

points.name: 强调谓语 do/does/did
points.structure: do/does/did + 动词原形
points.meaning: 强调谓语，常用于肯定与对比
points.example: The method does reduce error, though slowly.
points.translation: 该方法确实能减少误差，尽管很慢。

points.name: 双重否定
points.structure: not + 否定词（not uncommon/never without）
points.meaning: 两个否定表示委婉肯定
points.example: Such outcomes are not uncommon in field studies.
points.translation: 此类结果在实地研究中并不少见。

points.name: 部分否定
points.structure: not all/both/every/always
points.meaning: 表示并非全部
points.example: Not all participants completed the follow-up.
points.translation: 并非所有参与者都完成了随访。

points.name: 全部否定
points.structure: none/no one/neither/nothing/nobody
points.meaning: 表示全部否定
points.example: None of the samples met the criterion.
points.translation: 没有一个样本符合标准。

points.name: 否定转移
points.structure: I don't think/believe/suppose + 肯定从句
points.meaning: 否定形式在主句，否定的内容在从句
points.example: I don't think the two cases are comparable.
points.translation: 我认为这两个案例不可比较。

points.name: 间接引语时态后移
points.structure: said + (that) + 从句（时态后移一档）
points.meaning: 转述过去话语时时态向过去推移
points.example: She said the samples had been stored overnight.
points.translation: 她说样本已存放了一夜。

points.name: 间接引语句式转换
points.structure: asked/told + 陈述语序 / to do
points.meaning: 疑问句还原语序，祈使句改不定式
points.example: The supervisor asked whether the protocol had been approved.
points.translation: 主管询问方案是否已获批准。

points.name: 时态呼应例外
points.structure: 客观真理、习惯、仍有效的事实保持原时态
points.meaning: 不受主句过去时影响
points.example: The instructor explained that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
points.translation: 讲师解释水在摄氏100度沸腾。

points.name: 状语从句省略（主语+be）
points.structure: while/if/when/though + 分词/形容词（省略主语与 be）
points.meaning: 从句主语与主句一致且含 be 时可省略
points.example: While analyzing the data, the team noticed an outlier.
points.translation: 分析数据时团队注意到一个离群值。

points.name: 不定式符号的保留与省略
points.structure: and/or 并列时 to 可省或保留
points.meaning: 避免歧义时保留 to
points.example: The plan is to collect, clean, and analyze the data.
points.translation: 计划是收集、清洗并分析数据。

points.name: do so / so + 助动词 替代
points.structure: do so；so + do/be/have
points.meaning: 替代前文谓语或分句，避免重复
points.example: The first group completed the survey; the second did so later.
points.translation: 第一组完成问卷，第二组稍后完成。

points.name: one/ones 与 that/those 替代
points.structure: one(s) 替代可数泛指；that/those 替代特指
points.meaning: 替代名词短语以避免重复
points.example: The new sensors outperform those installed in 2015.
points.translation: 新传感器优于2015年安装的那些。

points.name: 名词化：动词转名词
points.structure: V → N（analyze→analysis；consume→consumption）
points.meaning: 提高学术语篇的信息密度与正式度
points.example: The analysis of the samples revealed contamination.
points.translation: 样本分析显示污染。

points.name: 名词化：形容词转名词
points.structure: adj → n（accurate→accuracy；dense→density）
points.meaning: 把属性转为可讨论的实体
points.example: The accuracy of the instrument was questioned.
points.translation: 仪器的准确性受到质疑。

points.name: 复合形容词
points.structure: 数词/名词/形容词 + 分词 + 名词（连字符）
points.meaning: 前置修饰，构成紧凑定语
points.example: a well-documented case
points.translation: 一个有充分记录的案例

points.name: 前缀派生
points.structure: un-/in-/dis-/re-/pre-/post- + 词根
points.meaning: 改变词义方向或时间关系
points.example: The findings are inconsistent with earlier work.
points.translation: 这些发现与早期研究不一致。

points.name: 后缀派生
points.structure: -tion/-ment/-ity/-ous/-ive/-ize
points.meaning: 改变词性
points.example: The results were reproducible across trials.
points.translation: 结果在各次试验中可复现。

points.name: 抽象名词的可数性
points.structure: research/evidence/knowledge 多作不可数
points.meaning: 学术抽象名词通常不加 -s
points.example: The evidence suggests a seasonal pattern.
points.translation: 证据显示一种季节性模式。

points.name: 介词短语后置修饰
points.structure: 名词 + prep + 名词（长定语后置）
points.meaning: 避免前置定语过长
points.example: The impact of urbanization on water quality is measurable.
points.translation: 城市化对水质的影响是可测量的。

points.name: 宾语补足语
points.structure: V + O + adj/n/to do/doing/done
points.meaning: 补充说明宾语的状态或动作
points.example: The committee declared the results invalid.
points.translation: 委员会宣布结果无效。

points.name: 复杂名词短语语序
points.structure: 限定词 + 前置修饰 + 中心名词 + 后置修饰
points.meaning: 多重修饰的层级排列
points.example: a rapidly growing body of evidence on urban heat
points.translation: 越来越多关于城市热岛的证据

points.name: 限定词序列
points.structure: all/both/half + the/these + 数词 + 名词
points.meaning: 限定词之间的固定顺序
points.example: All the other participants withdrew.
points.translation: 所有其他参与者都退出了。

points.name: 分裂句与伪分裂句
points.structure: It is X that...；What...is X
points.meaning: 两种信息焦点的安置方式
points.example: What the study needs is a larger sample.
points.translation: 该研究需要的是更大的样本。
points.note: 伪分裂句 what 从句

points.name: 主题化前置
points.structure: 宾语/状语 + 主语 + 谓语
points.meaning: 把已知信息或对比项提到句首
points.example: This hypothesis, few researchers have tested.
points.translation: 这一假设很少有人检验。

points.name: 右移位与信息焦点
points.structure: 把长而新的信息置于句末
points.meaning: 符合末端重量原则
points.example: A new explanation has emerged from the latest data.
points.translation: 最新数据中出现了新的解释。

points.name: 存在句扩展
points.structure: There + appear/seem/happen to be + 名词
points.meaning: 在存在句中嵌入情态或推测
points.example: There appears to be no consensus on the cause.
points.translation: 关于成因似乎没有共识。

points.name: 无动词分句
points.structure: 名词/形容词/介词短语独立作状语
points.meaning: 省略谓语，形成紧凑书面语
points.example: Although small in size, the sample was representative.
points.translation: 样本虽小却具代表性。

points.name: with 复合结构
points.structure: with + 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语
points.meaning: 表示伴随状况或原因
points.example: With the temperature falling, the reaction slowed.
points.translation: 随着温度下降，反应变慢。

points.name: 悬垂修饰语识别
points.structure: 句首分词/形容词短语 + 主句
points.meaning: 修饰语逻辑主语缺失或错位
points.example: Having reviewed the data, the conclusion seems sound.
points.translation: 审阅数据后，结论似乎合理。
points.note: 改为主句主语或加主语

points.name: 修饰语错位与歧义
points.structure: 副词/介词短语位置变动
points.meaning: 挂靠对象不明导致语义歧义
points.example: The team only tested the new sensor.
points.translation: 团队只测试了新传感器。

points.name: 比较从句的省略与还原
points.structure: than + 助动词/代词（省略重复部分）
points.meaning: 省略后须能唯一还原
points.example: The second trial was more costly than the first.
points.translation: 第二次试验比第一次成本更高。

points.name: 比较对象对等性
points.structure: 比较项须属同一范畴
points.meaning: 避免拿整体比部分
points.example: The climate of Tokyo is milder than that of Seoul.
points.translation: 东京气候比首尔温和。

points.name: 关系从句限定性歧义
points.structure: 同一从句加逗号与否改变所指
points.meaning: 限定性决定名词范围
points.example: The students, who had finished the exam, left early.
points.translation: 学生们考完试后早早离开。

points.name: 同位语与插入语
points.structure: 名词 + ,名词, / —名词—
points.meaning: 对前项作解释或补充
points.example: The hypothesis, a bold one, was never tested.
points.translation: 这一大胆假设从未被检验。

points.name: 破折号与冒号的语法功能
points.structure: — 解释/插入；: 引出列举或说明
points.meaning: 书面语中的停顿与说明关系
points.example: The result was unambiguous: the drug worked.
points.translation: 结果明确：药物有效。

points.name: 代词链与语篇衔接
points.structure: 代词回指前文名词，形成指代链
points.meaning: 保持话题连续，避免重复
points.example: The instrument failed; it had never been calibrated.
points.translation: 仪器失灵了，它从未校准过。

points.name: 省略与替代的衔接功能
points.structure: 省略重复成分，用 do so/one/that 替代
points.meaning: 减少冗余、维持连贯
points.example: Some studies support the claim; others do not.
points.translation: 一些研究支持该主张，另一些不支持。

points.name: 连接副词的语篇功能
points.structure: However/Therefore/Moreover + , + 分句
points.meaning: 表示分句间的逻辑关系，不能连接两个独立分句
points.example: The sample was small; nevertheless, the effect was clear.
points.translation: 样本虽小，效应却明显。

points.name: 逗号连接句（comma splice）
points.structure: 独立分句 , 独立分句
points.meaning: 两个完整句仅用逗号连接，属语法错误
points.example: The data were incomplete, the analysis was postponed.
points.translation: 数据不完整，分析被推迟。

points.name: 句子残缺（fragment）
points.structure: 从句/分词短语独立成句
points.meaning: 缺少主句或谓语
points.example: Because the sample was contaminated.
points.translation: 因为样本被污染了。

points.name: 流水句（run-on）
points.structure: 多个独立分句无标点连接
points.meaning: 句子界限不清
points.example: The trial ended the data were analyzed.
points.translation: 试验结束数据被分析。

points.name: 学术写作的时态选择
points.structure: 方法过去时；结论现在时；普遍事实现在时
points.meaning: 按时段与功能分配时态
points.example: The samples were heated; the results indicate a phase change.
points.translation: 样本被加热；结果表明相变。

points.name: 学术写作的被动与主动
points.structure: 方法用被动，论证用主动
points.meaning: 被动淡化施事，主动明确责任
points.example: The solution was filtered before analysis.
points.translation: 溶液在分析前被过滤。

points.name: 情态弱化与 hedging
points.structure: may/might/could/tend to/appear to
points.meaning: 降低断言强度，符合学术规范
points.example: The data suggest that the effect may be temporary.
points.translation: 数据表明该效应可能是暂时的。

points.name: 语域转换：口语到书面
points.structure: 口语词→书面词；短句→从句
points.meaning: 提升正式度与信息密度
points.example: The experiment did not work out as planned.
points.translation: 实验未按计划顺利进行。

points.name: 缩略形式与正式度
points.structure: don't→do not；can't→cannot
points.meaning: 学术写作不使用缩略形式
points.example: The results do not support the hypothesis.
points.translation: 结果不支持该假设。

points.name: 多重修饰的歧义消解
points.structure: 调整语序或改用从句明确挂靠
points.meaning: 避免修饰语跨层挂靠
points.example: The report on the study conducted in 2019 was withdrawn.
points.translation: 关于2019年开展的那项研究的报告被撤回。

points.name: 并列结构的逻辑层次
points.structure: 用 and/or 分层，避免平列不同层级
points.meaning: 区分同级并列与从属
points.example: The study examined cost, speed, and accuracy of detection.
points.translation: 研究考察了成本、速度与检测准确性。

points.name: 否定与情态的交互
points.structure: cannot 表不可能；may not 表不允许
points.meaning: 否定作用于情态还是命题
points.example: The results cannot be explained by chance.
points.translation: 结果不可能用偶然解释。

points.name: 条件句的语用功能
points.structure: if 从句表假设、礼貌、论辩前提
points.meaning: 同一形式承担多种语用功能
points.example: If we accept this premise, the conclusion follows.
points.translation: 若接受该前提，结论随之成立。

points.name: 让步与转折的语篇标记
points.structure: although/while/nevertheless/in contrast
points.meaning: 标记语义转折与对比
points.example: Although the cost fell, adoption remained low.
points.translation: 尽管成本下降，采用率仍低。

points.name: 因果语篇标记
points.structure: because/since/therefore/consequently/as a result
points.meaning: 标记因果链条
points.example: The sample was biased; consequently, the findings are limited.
points.translation: 样本有偏，因此结论有限。

points.name: 举例与详述标记
points.structure: for instance/specifically/namely
points.meaning: 引出例证或细化说明
points.example: Several factors matter, namely cost, access, and trust.
points.translation: 若干因素重要，即成本、可及性与信任。

points.name: 总结与归纳标记
points.structure: in sum/to conclude/overall
points.meaning: 收束论证、提炼结论
points.example: Overall, the evidence points to a modest effect.
points.translation: 总体而言，证据指向温和效应。

points.name: 递进与增补标记
points.structure: moreover/furthermore/in addition
points.meaning: 在同一方向上追加论据
points.example: Moreover, the effect persisted after six months.
points.translation: 此外，该效应六个月后仍持续。

points.name: while/whereas 的学术对比
points.structure: while/whereas + 分句表对照
points.meaning: 在同一句中安置两个对照命题
points.example: Urban demand rose, whereas rural demand declined.
points.translation: 城市需求上升，而乡村需求下降。

points.name: 被动语态的语篇衔接
points.structure: 被动使受事占据主语位置，承接上文话题
points.meaning: 维持话题链与信息流
points.example: The samples were collected in 2018 and were later reanalyzed.
points.translation: 样本于2018年采集，后来被重新分析。

points.name: 名词短语的信息密度
points.structure: 多重前置与后置修饰压缩信息
points.meaning: 学术语篇的典型特征
points.example: a long-term, multi-site study of soil erosion
points.translation: 一项关于土壤侵蚀的长期多站点研究

points.name: 修饰语堆叠的顺序
points.structure: 评价→大小→形状→年龄→颜色→来源→材料
points.meaning: 多个前置形容词的顺序规则
points.example: an impressive large-scale longitudinal study
points.translation: 一项令人印象深刻的大规模纵向研究

points.name: 冠词的语篇指称
points.structure: a 首次提及；the 回指或共享知识
points.meaning: 冠词承担前指与后指功能
points.example: A survey was conducted; the survey revealed a gap.
points.translation: 开展了一项调查；该调查揭示了差距。

points.name: 代词指代的性与数匹配
points.structure: 单数用 it/he/she，复数用 they
points.meaning: 避免性别默认与数不一致
points.example: Each respondent returned his or her form.
points.translation: 每位受访者交回了表格。
points.note: 避免 they 指单数名词

points.name: 学术建议句中的虚拟语气
points.structure: It is recommended that + S + (should) + V
points.meaning: 正式建议的表达方式
points.example: It is recommended that future studies control for seasonality.
points.translation: 建议未来研究控制季节性。

points.name: 强调结构在论证中的使用
points.structure: It is X that...；What...is X
points.meaning: 把论证焦点落在关键变量
points.example: It is the sampling frame, not the sample size, that limits validity.
points.translation: 限制效度的是抽样框而非样本量。

points.name: 长难句拆解策略
points.structure: 先找主谓，再逐层剥离从句与非谓语
points.meaning: 托福阅读长句理解方法
points.example: The claim that the policy, which was introduced in 2010, reduced emissions has been challenged.
points.translation: 关于2010年出台的政策减少排放的主张受到质疑。

points.name: 句子同义改写
points.structure: 保持命题真值，替换词汇与句法结构
points.meaning: 托福综合写作与改写题核心能力
points.example: Original: The policy cut emissions. Rewrite: Emissions fell as a result of the policy.
points.translation: 原句：政策减少了排放。改写：排放因该政策而下降。

rules.name: 主谓一致
rules.trigger: 主语为第三人称单数、并列主语、集合名词或 there be 结构时
rules.symptom: 动词原形与 -s 混用、并列主语只看最近名词、people/police 加 -s
rules.judgement: 先定中心词再定数，there be 取后置名词

rules.name: 时态选择
rules.trigger: 句中出现时间状语或上下文时间锚点
rules.symptom: 该用过去时用现在时、will 与 be going to 混用、时间从句用将来时
rules.judgement: 先判时间锚点，再判体（一般/进行/完成），主将从现单独记

rules.name: 完成体与一般过去时混用
rules.trigger: 有 already/just/yet 或明确过去时间
rules.symptom: yesterday 配现在完成、since 后接时间点却用过去时
rules.judgement: 有明确过去时间点用过去时，强调与现在的关联用完成体

rules.name: 进行体误用
rules.trigger: 动词为状态类（know/belong/contain/consist）
rules.symptom: I am knowing、The box is containing
rules.judgement: 状态动词一般不用于进行体，除非语义转为动态

rules.name: 被动语态构成
rules.trigger: 需要强调受事或施事不明
rules.symptom: 漏 be 动词、过去分词写成过去式、by 后接宾格错误
rules.judgement: be + 过去分词，时态落在 be 上

rules.name: 非谓语形式选择
rules.trigger: 句中已有谓语，第二动词需降级
rules.symptom: 两个谓语并列、to do 与 doing 混用
rules.judgement: 先看位置（主/宾/定/状），再查动词固定搭配

rules.name: 垂悬修饰语
rules.trigger: 句首分词或不定式短语
rules.symptom: 分词逻辑主语与主句主语不一致
rules.judgement: 分词动作的发出者必须等于主句主语，否则补主语或改从句

rules.name: 定语从句关系词选择
rules.trigger: 先行词为人/物/时间/地点/原因
rules.symptom: 人用 which、物用 who、缺状语用 that
rules.judgement: 先判先行词范畴，再判关系词在从句中的成分

rules.name: 限定与非限定定语从句
rules.trigger: 从句前有逗号或先行词为专有名词
rules.symptom: 非限定从句用 that、限定从句加逗号改变语义
rules.judgement: 逗号决定限定性，that 不进非限定从句

rules.name: 名词性从句连接词
rules.trigger: 从句作主语/宾语/表语/同位语
rules.symptom: that 与 what 混用、whether 写成 if 作主语
rules.judgement: 从句缺成分用 what，成分完整用 that；介词后与句首用 whether

rules.name: 状语从句连词冗余
rules.trigger: although/because 引导从句
rules.symptom: although...but、because...so 双连词
rules.judgement: 汉语成对关联词在英语只留一个

rules.name: 条件句时态搭配
rules.trigger: if/unless 引导条件从句
rules.symptom: 主句将来时、从句也将来时；if 后接 will
rules.judgement: 真实条件主将从现，从句用一般现在时

rules.name: 虚拟语气形式遗漏
rules.trigger: 与事实相反的条件、wish、as if
rules.symptom: if 从句用 was/were 混乱、主句用 will
rules.judgement: 现在相反过去式（be 用 were），过去相反 had done，主句 would/could have done

rules.name: 情态动词+完成式
rules.trigger: 对过去的推测或评价
rules.symptom: must have went、should have did
rules.judgement: 情态 + have + 过去分词，按推测强度选 must/may/might/can't

rules.name: 冠词缺失与误用
rules.trigger: 可数单数名词首次/再次出现
rules.symptom: 单数可数名词裸用、a 与 an 按字母而非音素选
rules.judgement: 单数可数名词必带限定词，a/an 看读音首音素

rules.name: 可数性与数量表达
rules.trigger: 名词为不可数或集合概念
rules.symptom: informations、researches、equipments、a advice
rules.judgement: 不可数名词不加 -s，用量词或 a piece of

rules.name: 介词搭配
rules.trigger: 动词/形容词后接固定介词
rules.symptom: discuss about、depend of、consist in
rules.judgement: 按词条记搭配，不按汉语直译

rules.name: 比较结构不完整
rules.trigger: as...as、more than、the same as
rules.symptom: 缺第二个 as、比较对象不对等
rules.judgement: 比较对象须同类，补齐助动词避免歧义

rules.name: 平行结构失衡
rules.trigger: and/or/but 或关联连词连接多项
rules.symptom: 名词与从句混排、to do 与 doing 并列
rules.judgement: 并列项词性与语法形式必须一致

rules.name: 代词指代与格
rules.trigger: 代词回指前文名词
rules.symptom: 主宾格混用、指代对象不唯一、数不一致
rules.judgement: 先定位唯一先行词，再定格与数

rules.name: 词性误用
rules.trigger: 修饰名词/动词/形容词的位置
rules.symptom: 形容词作状语、名词修饰动词、副词修饰名词
rules.judgement: 修饰名词用形容词，修饰动词/形容词用副词

rules.name: 修饰语位置错位
rules.trigger: only/almost/even/nearly 等限制性副词
rules.symptom: 位置变动导致语义偏移
rules.judgement: 限制性副词紧贴被修饰成分

rules.name: 倒装结构未倒装
rules.trigger: 否定词、only 状语、so/neither 置于句首
rules.symptom: 语序仍为陈述句
rules.judgement: 触发成分居首即部分倒装（助动词提前）

rules.name: 强调句结构混淆
rules.trigger: It is/was...that 结构
rules.symptom: 与定语从句混用、that 后成分残缺
rules.judgement: 去掉 It is...that 后句子仍完整才是强调句

rules.name: 否定范围与部分否定
rules.trigger: not 与 all/both/every/always 同现
rules.symptom: 把部分否定理解为全部否定
rules.judgement: not all 为部分否定，全部否定用 none/no one/neither

rules.name: 间接引语转换
rules.trigger: 直接引语改间接引语
rules.symptom: 语序未还原、时态未后移、人称未转换
rules.judgement: 疑问句还原陈述语序，时态后移一档，指示词与时间词同步转换

rules.name: 反意疑问句附加部分
rules.trigger: 陈述句后接简短问句
rules.symptom: 附加部分与主句人称/时态/肯定否定不一致
rules.judgement: 前肯后否、前否后肯，附加部分重复主句助动词

rules.name: 省略与替代不当
rules.trigger: 避免重复而省略或替代
rules.symptom: 省略后成分残缺、one/that/it 混用
rules.judgement: 省略须可还原；one 替代可数泛指，that 替代特指，it 指同一物

rules.name: 冗余与赘述
rules.trigger: 托福改写或学术写作
rules.symptom: repeat again、return back、the reason is because
rules.judgement: 删除语义重复项，一个句法槽只保留一个功能词

rules.name: 语域与正式度不符
rules.trigger: 学术写作、托福综合写作
rules.symptom: 口语缩略、俚语、第一人称过度使用
rules.judgement: 书面语用完整形式，减少 I/you，避免情感化表达

rules.name: 逗号连接句与连接副词误用
rules.trigger: 两个独立分句并列
rules.symptom: 逗号直接连接、however 当连词用
rules.judgement: 独立分句须用分号、句号或并列连词；连接副词后置逗号

rules.name: 数的一致（名词与限定词）
rules.trigger: this/these、a number of、the number of
rules.symptom: this data、a number of student
rules.judgement: 限定词与被修饰名词数一致，a number of 接复数谓语用复数

rules.name: 非谓语固定搭配
rules.trigger: 动词后接 to do 或 doing
rules.symptom: enjoy to do、want doing、suggest to do
rules.judgement: 按动词记搭配，suggest/avoid/enjoy 接 doing

rules.name: 形容词+介词固定搭配
rules.trigger: be + 形容词 + 介词
rules.symptom: be good in、be interested on、be capable to
rules.judgement: 整体记搭配：good at、interested in、capable of

rules.name: 关系从句与同位语混淆
rules.trigger: 名词后接 that 从句
rules.symptom: 把同位语从句当定语从句分析成分
rules.judgement: 同位语从句成分完整，定语从句缺成分

rules.name: 比较级最高级形式
rules.trigger: 长短形容词、不规则形容词
rules.symptom: more better、most easiest、gooder
rules.judgement: 单音节加 -er/-est，多音节加 more/most，不叠加

rules.name: 主动被动语义倒置
rules.trigger: 主语与动词逻辑关系判断
rules.symptom: The book wrote by...、实验被做成了主动
rules.judgement: 先判主语是施事还是受事，再选语态

rules.name: 时间/条件从句的将来表达
rules.trigger: when/if/before/after 引导从句
rules.symptom: 从句用 will
rules.judgement: 主句将来时，从句用一般现在时或现在完成时

rules.name: 名词化与可数性
rules.trigger: 学术写作中动词/形容词转名词
rules.symptom: make an analysis of 冗余、名词化后数不一致
rules.judgement: 名词化后检查可数性与搭配介词

rules.name: 句子完整性
rules.trigger: 长句、从句嵌套
rules.symptom: 缺谓语、缺主语、两个谓语无连接
rules.judgement: 每句一个主谓核心，从句须有引导词
